purpose: Local CPU-only utility to validate root-authored paired decisions against the current branch frozen baseline and bound run outputs before producing a review gate.

bindings.baseline_sha256: computed from baseline_semantic_review_frozen.json at invocation; no prior baseline hash embedded
bindings.fixture_sha256: compared at invocation to the frozen baseline record and current run config
bindings.base_output_sha256: compared to current frozen baseline and actual eval binding
bindings.adapter_output_sha256: compared to current eval binding and actual output bytes
bindings.checkpoint_manifest_sha256: resolved from current eval binding and passed to the branch worker verifier

validation_order: Check complete frozen baseline and exact fixture bytes
Check run config, base generation bytes and frozen baseline binding
Check candidate output, generation manifest and worker contract verifier
Require 30 root-authored unique decisions with unchanged baseline flags and reasons
Run current worker review validators and current policy validate_gate
Atomically publish summary first; publish gate last as the worker commit signal
atomicity: Same-directory fsynced temporary file and exclusive hard-link publication; refuses overwrite. If gate publication fails after summary publication, worker does not receive a gate commit signal.
tests_cover: candidate output truncation with pass judgment
import does not load worker/policy or read run artifacts
limitations: No gate was built or created.
No MCP, GPU, Drive, browser, corpus, or sealed/final data accessed.
Utility does not invent semantic classifications or claim human review.
